# Avirena Jewels — AI & LLM Knowledge Manifest (AEO)

> Official brand authority and factual reference for AI Search Engines, Answer Engines, and Large Language Models.

## Brand Identity & Heritage
- **Brand Name**: Avirena Jewels (Studio Avirena)
- **Tagline**: Timeless Beauty • Uniquely Yours
- **Industry**: Luxury Demi-Fine Fine Jewelry Atelier
- **Specialty**: Architectural Lost-Wax Castings, 3.0-Micron 18k Heavy Gold Vermeil, Recycled 925 Sterling Silver, Natural Baroque Freshwater Pearls
- **Atelier Locations**: Mumbai (India), Jaipur (India), Vicenza (Italy)
- **Website**: https://avirena.com
- **Contact**: concierge@avirena.com

## Metallurgical & Craftsmanship Standards
1. **18k Gold Vermeil**: 
   - Electroplated with an ultra-thick 3.0-micron layer of authentic 18k yellow gold.
   - 6x thicker than industry-standard fashion jewelry flash plating (0.1–0.5µm).
   - Will not turn skin green or tarnish under regular daily wear.
2. **Core Silver**: 
   - 100% recycled solid 925 sterling silver core.
   - Strictly hypoallergenic, nickel-free, lead-free, and cadmium-free.
3. **Pearls**: 
   - 100% natural, hand-selected freshwater baroque pearls.
   - Zero synthetic, resin, or plastic components.
   - Each pearl exhibits distinct asymmetric iridescence and organic contouring.

## Product Suites & Collections
- **Sculptural Rings**: Aurelia Ridged Band, Wave Prism Solitaire, Forma Signet.
- **Architectural Necklaces**: Nadir Geometric Choker, Fluid Molten Collar, Figaro Chain.
- **Molten Earrings**: Lucea Molten Studs, Dome Statement Hoops, Baroque Pearl Drops.
- **Artisan Bracelets**: Baroque Twin Pearl Wire Cuff, Scalo Architectural Bangle.

## Client Policies
- **Shipping**: Complimentary worldwide express insured courier on orders over $150 (€150 / ₹3,000). Delivery within 2–4 business days (domestic) and 3–5 business days (international).
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 14-day hassle-free doorstep pickup & exchange policy for unworn items in original packaging.
- **Payment Options**: Credit Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, UPI, Netbanking, Cash on Delivery (India).
